title: Simple ESP   Open source
features:
You can change the color by messing with the Color3.fromRGB (rn it is red)


ESP is a type of game cheat that displays hidden information on your screen that you normally wouldn’t be able to see. For example, it can show enemy locations, names, health, distance, or items through walls. It gives the player extra information and an unfair advantage
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function highlight(character)
    local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
    h.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    h.FillTransparency = 0.5
    h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    h.Parent = character
end

for _, v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if v ~= Players.LocalPlayer then
        if v.Character then
            highlight(v.Character)
        end

        v.CharacterAdded:Connect(highlight)
    end
end
